description: 连续将军逼王就范，后串击王和黑后
explanation_en: A remarkable skewer built with a series of checks. White maneuvers the king onto d6, then uses the queen to attack the king with Black's queen on a3 behind it.

intro.popup: 💡 串击：白方连续将军把黑王逼到d6，再用后串击黑王和a3的后。
intro.popup_en: 💡 Skewer: White uses a series of checks to drive the black king to d6, then skewers it and the queen on a3.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Qf8+串击！后攻击d6的王，对角线延伸到a3的后——王一动白后吃后。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Qf8+ skewers the king on d6, with the queen on a3 behind it along the diagonal. When the king moves, White captures the queen.

moves.popup: 后到h6将军，驱赶f8的王——连续将军布局的第一步。
moves.popup_en: The queen checks from h6, driving the king from f8. This is the first step in the checking sequence.
The king is forced to move to e7.

moves.popup: 后到g7再将！引诱黑王吃d6的白马，走到串击位置。
moves.popup_en: The queen checks again from g7, luring the king to capture the knight on d6 and enter the skewer line.

moves.popup: 黑王吃马来到d6——落入陷阱！d6正好在f8到a3的对角线上。
moves.popup_en: The king captures the knight on d6 and falls into the trap: d6 lies on the diagonal from f8 to a3.

moves.popup: 后到f8串击！对角线直穿d6的王直到a3的后——这就是串击！
moves.popup_en: The queen checks from f8, skewering the king on d6 with the queen on a3 behind it. That is the skewer!

moves.popup: 黑王逃离，a3的后已无处可逃。
moves.popup_en: The king escapes, leaving the queen on a3 unable to get away.

moves.popup: 后吃黑后！串击成功，白方赢得黑后。
moves.popup_en: White's queen captures Black's queen on a3. The skewer succeeds.
